verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents its own reschedule capability: an API that moves accepted or pending bookings to a new time, and slot lookups that free the original booking's time for rescheduling. Its webhook and Zapier triggers show that rescheduled and cancelled bookings are first-class events. Nothing shows invitees doing this self-service from their confirmation, policies being enforced, or every calendar being updated. missing for 10: invitee self-serve reschedule/cancel links from the confirmation, enforced reschedule/cancellation policies (notice windows, limits), documented calendar updates on reschedule/cancel, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere

citations.quote: Reschedule a booking or seated booking. Reschedulable booking statuses: - `accepted` — the confirmed booking is moved to the new start time. - `pending` — a booking awaiting host confirmation can be rescheduled.
provide the booking's unique identifier to exclude its time slot from busy time calculations. This ensures the original booking time appears as available for rescheduling.
Use the Cal.com Zapier app to automate your workflows when a booking is created, rescheduled, cancelled or when a meeting ends.
